27:14.text: wrongfully and arrogantly, though their ownselves were convinced thereof
[i.e. those (Ayât ) are from Allâh, and Mûsâ (Moses) is the Messenger of Allâh in truth, but they disliked to obey Mûsâ (Moses), and hated to believe in his Message of Monotheism]
. So see what was the end of the Mufsidûn
(disbelievers, disobedient to Allâh, evil-doers and liars.)

27:15.text: And indeed We gave knowledge to Dâwûd
, and they both said: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has preferred us above many of His believing slaves!"

27:16.text: . He said: "O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and on us have been bestowed all things. This, verily, is an evident grace

27:17.text: And there were gathered before Sulaimân
his hosts of jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order

27:18.text: Till, when they came to the valley of the ants, one of the ants said: "O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulaimân
and his hosts should crush you, while they perceive not."

27:19.text: and said: "My Lord! Grant me the power and ability that I may be grateful for Your Favours which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your Mercy among Your righteous slaves."

27:20.text: He inspected the birds, and said: "What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?

27:21.text: "I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason."

27:22.text: But the hoopoe stayed not long: he
which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba’
